# Shared-account character selection work order

Revision 4, 2026-10-09. Authored implementation specification; no admission, generated implementation, execution or receiving is claimed.

## Scope and genuine type boundary

Construct one shared pure partial selector inside the existing Organizing owner. The selected construction route for this correction is explicitly authored source with independent owner assays specified and frozen before implementation; it is not supplier-generated output. It is a refactoring of the existing cast law, not a new identity or authorization engine. Apply the selector through current owner adapters to the accepted native world and host consumers. The source-free Modules planning projection below covers only the pure JSON export; the native Map/session/actor consumers are mandatory independent acceptance obligations in this same work order.

Pure domain: one strict JSON record {subject: nonempty canonical string, associatedBearers: array of nonempty canonical strings, bearer?: nonempty canonical string}. This is an internal current-relation projection supplied by the trusted owner, never a public authority argument. Remove subject from the association set and deduplicate without mutating input. References are canonical before this boundary; the pure function does not resolve names.

Synchronous successful codomain: exactly {subject: unchanged input subject, bearer: selected canonical string}. Synchronous obstruction codomain: native TypeError for unrelated explicit bearer or ambiguous omitted bearer, with no successful output. Preserve TypeError through cast; actual world/host operation boundaries retain their existing typed obstruction envelope. No invented successful refusal JSON or replacement principal is permitted. Schema-invalid inputs remain outside the declared operation domain.

The actual adapter domain remains current agency/Map, current told-hand testimony, authenticated subject, validated optional native network face and requested bearer. Canonicalize only with the existing unique owner resolver, then union bearersHandedBy(handedAgency(binding,currentAgency),subject) and the current authored character validated from binding.resolveActorSubject(subject). An invalid native face refuses before helper invocation. The cast specialization has no native face. The projection is recreated after suspension and at each relevant effect/read boundary; retaining a selected connection never retains authorization.

Current preparation base: Computer 0165ed9c674fe82cf87b9dba52446fd6a3985f7c. Full baseline paths and blob identities are in baseline-source-manifest.json. ## Pure projection requirements

- preserve-authenticated-subject: For every admitted record, return the unchanged subject with the selected bearer; a bearer choice never rewrites subject.
- explicit-associated-bearer: If bearer is supplied and equals a member of associatedBearers, select that exact canonical bearer independently of list order.
- explicit-subject-self: If bearer is supplied and equals subject, select subject, including when the account has other associated bearers, preserving the existing cast subject-self exception.
- omit-unique-association: If bearer is absent and the distinct associatedBearers excluding subject has exactly one member, select that member.
- omit-no-association: If bearer is absent and the distinct associatedBearers excluding subject is empty, select subject under the established no-association self rule.
- refuse-unrelated-selection: If supplied bearer is neither subject nor a member of associatedBearers, throw TypeError and return no selection; the message names subject and refused bearer.
- refuse-ambiguous-omission: If bearer is absent and more than one distinct associated bearer remains after excluding subject, throw TypeError and return no selection; the message names subject and says to select the bearer.
- set-presentation-invariance: Repeated members and any permutation of associatedBearers preserve the selected result or TypeError refusal; subject appearing in associatedBearers is ignored for association cardinality.
- fresh-input-determines-selection: Each invocation is determined solely by its supplied current record; a later record without a previously selected association refuses that explicit bearer even when an earlier invocation succeeded.
- selected-pair-only: Successful output is exactly the JSON record with subject and bearer; it carries no account grants, caller hand, connection authority, display name, witness or fabricated authorization claim.
- deterministic-pure-operation: The operation does not mutate its input, retain selection state or perform file, environment, network, clock, randomness, grant, account or credential effects; equivalent records yield equivalent selected pairs or the same refusal class.

- synchronous-native-contract: The export is synchronous: an admitted successful call returns the plain selected pair directly, never a Promise or thenable; a refusing call throws TypeError before returning, preserving synchronous playerOfAct callers.

## Pure projection prohibitions

- no-first-choice: Never choose an arbitrary first, last, lexicographically least or least-hash member when omitted selection is ambiguous.
- no-refusal-fallback: Never replace an invalid explicit selection or ambiguous omission with subject-self, a different associated bearer, a previously selected bearer or any caller/display-derived identity.
- no-implicit-canonicalization: Never normalize spelling, casing, trim identity strings, parse display names or invent aliases inside the pure operation; its references are already canonically supplied by the owner adapter.
- no-input-mutation: Never mutate associatedBearers or any other input property while deduplicating or ordering the selection.
- no-stale-authorization: Never treat a previous successful record as authorization for a later record; the pure function has no authority registry or cached bearer eligibility.

## Effect and completion boundary

Pure plan is authorized and creates no inferred source. Root has separately selected the explicitly authored implementation route because no supported included inference binding has been established; prewrite and review genuine owner assays before authoring implementation and apply exact source through the existing guarded writer. Derivation may proceed only through an actual supported carrier whose runtime effect and no-spend status are established; an unbound carrier is a blocker, not a default purchased route. Existing owner codemod/application must be recovered and exercised against current exact source. This order authorizes no remote publication, native operation, account association, credential, grant, mask, security, network or deployment change.

No unresolved choice remains in the mathematical pure selection contract. Executable closure, provider effect binding and source-application availability are operational prerequisites tracked outside semantic open questions. Their absence does not make unexecuted obligations pass.
